name: Quanticor
role: Native quantum-level observation, fault-learning, multidimensional mapping and optimisation subsystem.
principles: Observe systems and their behaviour before prescribing code changes.
Record unfinished states, faults, regressions, negative-space gates and recovery paths.
Generate multidimensional computational maps across source, modules, adapters, capabilities, runtime states and provenance.
Use blockchain anchoring for evidence/provenance; blockchain is an integrity anchor, not the sole storage layer.
Retain AS-IS functionality tree as control and compare native-integrated tree against it.
Treat quantum concepts as computational/research models unless physical quantum hardware evidence exists.
Use native-first execution; federation is intentional and capability-driven.
Preserve independent subsystem operation and historical archives.

components.fault_learning: fault -> context -> hypothesis -> repair -> regression map
components.negative_space: explicit representation of absent/blocked/forbidden/unavailable paths as gates
components.multidimensional_map: graph/hypergraph of code, capabilities, dependencies, states, faults, performance and provenance
components.blockchain_anchor: hash/Merkle-root/event anchors for map snapshots and evidence
components.intentional_federation: controlled interaction tests between subsystems; collisions are simulated in quarantine, not destructive production execution
components.clean_path: promoted verified path separated from failed/experimental paths
components.heterogeneous_twin: renamed Buipui Heterogeneous System digital-twin layer
components.optimisation: simultaneous multi-system objective evaluation after functional equivalence
components.code_partitioning: experimental quantum-inspired decomposition of non-required/redundant code; no deletion without evidence and human-approved promotion

safety_boundary: Do not intentionally corrupt production code or systems.
Federation collision tests run in disposable/quarantine branches or sandboxes.
Destructive/invalid paths are recorded as data and never executed against authoritative builds.
Quantum behaviour is not asserted merely from software abstractions.
quantum_model_note: The requested 'more than one place at once' concept is represented as a superposition/alternative-state research model, not as a claim that classical code physically occupies multiple quantum states. Quantum no-cloning and other physical constraints remain authoritative.
future_research: photonic and crystal-based intelligence remain research tracks; implementation requires physical architecture/evidence before promotion.
